notes.title: Devlog #23: Development Progress and Best Wishes!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, ZooKeepers! ❄️[/h2]

It’s time for the last devlog of this year! Plenty of things have changed in ZooKeeper since the last update and today we’d like to tell you all about it!

Let’s start with something we were talking about in the last devlog. 

[h3]❕ Zoo selection menu – a little update[/h3]

We finished adding finishing touches to the [b]zoo zelection menu[/b]. To be specific, [b]transition animation has been added[/b] to allow you to smoothly move from one zoo to another.

For a comparison, here is the selection menu how it appeared in the previous devlog…

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Y3YK5yU.gif[/img]

…and here is the selection menu now! 😃

[img]https://i.imgur.com/aJT6Lt5.gif[/img]

[h3]⭐ Have a Star![/h3]

Another thing you may recall from the last devlog is a [b]Star rewarding system[/b]. We didn’t get to reveal much about it back then, but now we can tell you more about it! 😊

Every zoo map has 3 tasks, which reward you with Stars upon completion. ⭐⭐⭐

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34740129/391e9be8d846585a87e2b8e408dde6bafa1fafae.png[/img]

You can review how many Stars are available on a given map from the zoo selection menu. The map’s thumbnail will tell you how many starts you already have and how many you have yet to get. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34740129/1ed7a99a9e812fbb7f6c37add7b3b3cedff32837.png[/img]

What is the purpose of those Stars? They can be exchanged for [b]prizes[/b] – prestigious statues you can decorate your zoo with!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34740129/caaf0263a115b097cbb34b264894c9cd2e3577b2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34740129/f6401aa4a1555ee87e053691fcbab3c6b5ab9e98.png[/img]

Aren’t they fancy? ✨

[h3]⚙️ More options in Settings menu[/h3]

These may not as exciting news as above feature, but they’re no less important! 

We have included [b]Camera sensitivity[/b] option in Settings menu, which allows you set the camera movements’ speed to your liking. We know each one of you has unique preferences and the default settings might not always work best – in the past, we also had trouble capturing what we wanted to show you at times due to camera moving too quickly and moving far away from our desired spot. We hope this setting will prove helpful for you as well. 🙂

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34740129/c817c886bf79b4cecbd9ea2aeed6bd0f07ce261d.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fIb2idX.gif[/img]

You can also turn off [b]chromatic aberration effect[/b] from the Settings menu if have a need for it. 

[h3]📝 End the day with an Autosave![/h3]

The title says it all – instead of saving manually all the time, [b]the game will now be saved automatically at the end of the day[/b]. That way, you won’t need to worry about your progress and can focus on looking after animals! 💪

[h3]🔨 Get rid of multiple objects at once[/h3]

There are times when you need to remove multiple objects from you zoo. Getting rid of them manually one by one might work in some cases, but it might get tedious if you have created vast flower fields or tiny forests in your zoo. That’s why we have added an option to [b]sell multiple objects at once[/b]. When you enter Selling mode by clicking the Bulldozer icon, hold the left mouse button and expand the selection to cover all of the objects you’d like to delete. 
And...

[img]https://i.imgur.com/UYhYJsl.gif[/img]

They’re gone!

[h3]🐘 A list of zoo animals for your convenience[/h3]

A good list always comes in handy! We have improved the list of all your zoo animals. [b]You can now sort them by enclosure, look them up by typing their name or give them their own individual names[/b]! 🤩

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34740129/fa2683d367ac333c025067a344b8e6802fbbc6cb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34740129/4d89bd5bc206525bfaaf514fac51ab765501cd62.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34740129/6f10aa3cac53a11af7478bb1989362192ea2b33f.png[/img]

That’s all we’d like to share with you today. If ZooKeeper caught your interest, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1027810/ZooKeeper/?utm_source=zoodevlog23][b]add the game to your Wishlist[/b][/url] to stay up to date with development progress! As always, we also invite you to [url=https://discord.gg/sv9UWeh][b]join our Discord channel[/b][/url]!

Now, as an end note…

[h3]🎄 Merry Christmas![/h3]

We’d like to wish you a merry Christmas celebration! It may be different in different countries or even families, but it’s still a time of great importance we can spend with our families and closest ones! 😊 We hope you’ll be able to make the best use of it and enjoy it to the fullest. Rest up and get ready for a New Year!

We’ll be back with another devlog in 2022! 🙌

Stay well and take care,
ZooKeeper Team

notes.title: Devlog #22: Zoo Selection Menu
notes.content:
[h2]Hello again, ZooKeepers! 🐼[/h2]

We may have been quiet for a while, but we’re as busy as ever! We’re now at a stage of constant testing, fixing and various improvements. Most of the tasks we’re handling lean on a technical side and so, they are difficult to show you in a graphical form.

The one thing we can show you, though, is [b]the new zoo selection menu[/b]!

[b]This is how the selection menu used to look like not long ago.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34740129/51af665ced86367ee5666ef68122de96dc18ba41.png[/img]

You could choose the area by pressing the arrows to the left or to the right and then, you would see an overview of the currently chosen zoo. An overview included a name, a short description and a rotating view of the area.

While it had its charm, there was room for improvement. Most notably, you may notice how you can only see the area you’ve chosen. There was no way to get a glimpse of the other zoo areas other than just aimlessly clicking through every other option. It wasn’t exactly practical for that reason.

Hopefully, the text in Polish won’t bother you too much – if you’re curious, though, “Dolina Kreatywności” stands for “Creativity Valley” and that’s the name of the area you see here. 🙂

[b]Nowadays, zoo selection menu looks like this:[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/57VBs3q.gif[/img]

As you can see, it’s much more intuitive and easier to navigate than it was before! While browsing through various locations, you’ll be able to see a glimpse of three options at once – the one that’s currently chosen, the previous one according to selection’s order, as well as the one that comes right after the chosen one. If you see an interesting location among three options visible, you can pick an area by clicking on its thumbnail, which is definitely more intuitive than having to stick to arrows all the time. 😄

[b]How do you like it?[/b]

We are also preparing a Star awarding system, but we can’t show you it just yet, as the work is still in progress – we’ll leave details for the next devlog instead. 🙂

That’s it from us! We’ll keep working on the game to make it as relaxing and fun as possible! 💪 If ZooKeeper caught your attention, consider adding the game to your Wishlist and stay up to date with development progress! You can also [url=https://discord.gg/sv9UWeh][b]join our Discord channel[/b][/url] and talk to us about this or any other game we’re working on! 🎮

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1027810/ZooKeeper/

Thank you for your support! ❤️

Stay well,
[b]ZooKeeper Team[/b]

notes.title: Devlog #21: VIP Visitors and more!
notes.content:
[h2][h3]Hi there, ZooKeepers! 🐘[/h3][/h2]

We apologize for the silence. We have been working hard on ZooKeeper and we did our best to keep you updated on our progress via our other social media, but we realize not all of you follow us beyond Steam. 

So, we have decided to gather all our little achievements we made since our last devlog and show them to you all here. Let’s get started!

🍦 [b]New buildings – new attractions for your visitors[/b]

At the early stage, all you could get for your hungry visitors was a hotdog booth. Now, there is much more to choose from, as we have added ice cream, pizza, hamburger, lemonade booths and even a stand with merchandise!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34740129/609bc9da2d8e44787547e4d37fdb57ff56e9d4d5.png[/img]

⏱️ [b]Employees moving at the right speed [/b]

We have tried to figure out the best way for the zoo workers to move around various enclosures. We have considered different options and admittedly, there were many difficulties along the way, but in the end, we have decided on a more simplistic solution. As long as you place a special booth in every enclosure, your employees will be able to travel between them underground by entering one enclosure, and leaving through the other, in another enclosure! Perhaps it’s not the most realistic approach, but – as we believe – it should work well with the pace of the gameplay and lowpoly aesthetic of the game. It allows the workers to move efficiently and quickly, allowing the player to relax and saving him the frustration of NPCs reacting too slowly.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZkeEuYM.gif[/img]

🐣 [b]Baby animals[/b]

That’s right! If you make sure your animal has another companion of the same species, you might find an adorable surprise in the enclosure! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HE6h9Xl.gif[/img]

⭐ [b]VIP Visitors[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jKRhpBj.gif[/img]

As VIP part indicates, they are special individuals whose satisfaction is essential to you and your zoo’s growth. You can recognize them by a golden glow and a crown floating above their heads. Contrary to other visitors, YOU are the one who needs to control them and point them in the right direction during their visit. Unattended, they just stand idly and wait for pointers.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/U7YMDS5.gif[/img]

You can think of them as celebrities, who expect all your attention the moment they step into your zoo. Handling them requires more effort, but it’s very much worth it! It may also be a nice change of pace compared to usual visits. 

What do you think of these additions? Let us know here or [url=https://discord.gg/sv9UWeh]join our Discord Community[/url] and talk to us there! 💬

Thank you all for your support! ❤️ Stay tuned for upcoming updates and keep following the game on Steam!

Kind Regards,
ZooKeeper Team

We’ve recently implemented terrain painting to the game, which will allow you to create more realistic animal enclosures and unleash your creativity even more! 🎨

After you’ve built animal enclosure, you can paint the terrain and create an appropriate biome for animals that you keep there! The game will let you feel like a true artist and design unique Zoo! But how it works? First off, you have to enter the creative mode and left-click on the globe icon. 🌍

Then choose the type of terrain from the list, and start painting! Lastly, check if your animals are satisfied with what you’ve created for them. ːsteamhappyː You can change the terrain anytime you want, but keep in mind that animals may not like it.

Stay tuned for upcoming devlogs and keep following the game on Steam! If you have any questions or just want to know more about the game, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/663YE5a]discord server[/url]!  

Have a great weekend!

notes.title: Devlog #9: Staff Members
notes.content:
[h1]Hello ZooKepers![/h1]

Let’s talk about staff members, which you can employ to take care of your animal park. 

Apart from creating your dream Zoo, you have to also manage your staff members. As a good leader, you should be aware that your staff members are not only a big help for you, but also a great responsibility. You have to properly supervise them and also remember to pay them on time.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fD2Mg3D.gif[/img]

Besides, you should also be aware that each staff member has a satisfaction level, responsible for the willingness to do their job. Satisfied employees perform their tasks easily. When an employee’s satisfaction level drops to zero, you’ll notice that their free will is turned off, and in this case you have to give them instructions, or let them rest for a while. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/VXD1Pyi.gif[/img]

What is more, each employee has one favorite task, and while doing it, the satisfaction level increases. Additionally, the satisfaction level is also connected with a staff member’s skill rank. You may observe that the satisfaction level drops slower when an employee has a high skill rank. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TKDL23K.gif[/img]

Lastly, we would like to add that your awesome employees have an amazing super power. They can teleport themselves between animal enclosures, so there’s no need to wait until they finally move from one biome to another. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7EUUVFD.gif[/img]

Manage your staff members properly and become the greatest ZooKeeper! Keep following the game on Steam and stay tuned for upcoming updates! If you have any questions or just want to know more about the game, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/663YE5a]Discord server[/url]!  

Best Regards,
ZooKeeper Team
